S2_row_axis.VAR_BLOCKS: Ordered variable blocks; each variable continuous (statistic rows) or categorical (category rows). No timepoint dimension.
S2_row_axis.CATEGORY_LIST: One or a few predefined subject-status/category lists (disposition, analysis sets, deviations, deaths, AE overview flags).
S2_row_axis.CODED_HIERARCHY: Dictionary-coded terms (SOC/PT, ATC/PN, AESI category/PT, PT only), data-driven rows, 1-2 levels.
S2_row_axis.BY_TIMEPOINT: Parameter x visit/timepoint rows; cell content continuous or categorical (S4 decides).
S2_row_axis.CROSSTAB: Category-by-category cross-classification (baseline vs post-baseline shift, concordance of two assessments).
S2_row_axis.ENDPOINT_ANALYSIS: Endpoint summary rows mixed with inferential rows (rates with CI, KM medians, model estimates, tests).
S2_row_axis.SUBJECT_RECORDS: Listing: one row per record; record fields as columns.
S2_row_axis.REFERENCE_CATALOG: Listing without subjects: a catalog of protocol items (e.g. eligibility criteria text).

S3_col_axis.GROUPS: Repeated treatment/cohort group columns, optional Total.
S3_col_axis.GROUPS_PLUS_COMPARISON: Group columns followed by between-group comparison columns (difference, OR, HR, p-value).
S3_col_axis.GROUPS_X_SUBCOL: Each group split into fixed sub-columns (e.g. n(%) and events, N' and n(%)).
S3_col_axis.CATEGORY_COLS: Columns are categories of an outcome (post-baseline category, grade, disposition status).
S3_col_axis.STATS_COLS: Columns are statistics (n, Mean, SD, ...); groups/timepoints on rows or pages.

S4_cell_semantics.EVENTS: Event counts (with or without percentage of events).
S4_cell_semantics.DESC: Descriptive statistics of a continuous variable.
S4_cell_semantics.DESC_MIXED: Continuous descriptive and categorical n(%) blocks in the same table.
S4_cell_semantics.PK_DESC: Descriptive statistics including geometric mean / CV%.
S4_cell_semantics.RATE_CI: Proportions with confidence intervals (optionally with between-group test).
S4_cell_semantics.MODEL_EST: Model-based or nonparametric estimates (LS means, differences, Hodges-Lehmann) with CI/p.
S4_cell_semantics.TTE_EST: Time-to-event estimates (events/censored, KM quantiles with CI, HR, log-rank).

S5_nesting.BY_PARAM_VISIT: Parameter blocks, each repeated per visit.
S5_nesting.BY_GROUP_BLOCK: Treatment groups appear as row blocks instead of columns.
S5_nesting.SUBROWS_BY_CATEGORY: Each term row split into category sub-rows (grade, severity, relationship).
S5_nesting.LISTING_SUBJECT: Listing grain: one record per subject.
S5_nesting.LISTING_SUBJECT_EVENT: Listing grain: multiple coded/numbered records per subject (no visit axis).
S5_nesting.LISTING_SUBJECT_VISIT: Listing grain: subject x visit, measures as columns (wide).
S5_nesting.LISTING_SUBJECT_PARAM_VISIT: Listing grain: subject x parameter x visit (long).

S6_plot_type.SUMMARY_OVER_TIME: Group summary statistic (mean / percentage) over time.
S6_plot_type.INDIVIDUAL_PROFILE: Individual subject trajectories over time (spider / spaghetti).
S6_plot_type.WATERFALL: Ordered per-subject bars of best change.
S6_plot_type.TORNADO: Mirrored horizontal bars by term for two groups.
